description:
Track the user's own extension from its Chrome Web Store and/or Firefox Add-ons URL.
Resolve a name with search_catalog first; pass the selected result's url. Do not guess
between ambiguous listings or start tracking research results without the user's request.

Supply both URLs in one call only when they are the same product: they share one
extension_id and consume one plan slot. Repeating an existing URL is a no-op, including
at the cap. If one URL matches existing tracking, its missing store is attached and
existing keywords are adopted. Conflicting listings are refused, never replaced or merged.

Free allows 1 tracked extension; Premium allows 10.
The response includes current usage and limits. A plan_limit_reached error is not retryable
unchanged: explain it, offer the pricing link, or ask which existing extension the user
wants removed with remove_extension. Never delete tracking automatically to free a slot.

Cached metrics may be available immediately; fresh metrics run in the background.
Use get_extension and list_scrape_runs to check progress; do not promise a completion time.

Needs an ExtensionDash account: sign in from your app, e.g. `claude mcp login extensions-dashboard` or `codex mcp login extensions-dashboard`.

chrome_url.description: HTTPS Chrome Web Store listing URL; at least one store URL is required.

firefox_url.description: HTTPS Firefox Add-ons listing URL, optionally paired with the same product's Chrome URL.
